question: Construction of the Hawa Mahal at Jaipur was inspired by the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khetri Mahal at Jhunjhunu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Hawa Mahal** at Jaipur was inspired by Khetri Mahal or the Wind Palace in Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan. 
 
• It was built by Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh, the grandson of Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh, who was the founder of the city of Jaipur. </li&g
